title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated user who can influence indexed event data could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated user who can influence indexed event data may cause the system to execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands when an authenticated user interacts with certain workflow actions. This occurs because the affected workflow actions insert event-field values directly into searches without proper validation or quoting. Exploitation could allow unauthorized access or modification of sensitive data and disruption of services for the authenticated user. The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-131236 with a high severity rating.
